fields.principle: Classify the stated source as observed, likely (supported), possible, not determined, or historical-reportedly-repaired. 'Observed' means the active source was seen or moisture was measured at it; a stain alone is 'likely'. The wording should match the evidence.

note: Defined 'observed': the active source was seen or moisture was measured at it. A stain alone is 'likely'.
